# Paige Vaughn

> Paige Vaughn is an Austin, Texas-based product and marketing strategist with 11+ years of experience across go-to-market strategy, customer research, pricing, brand strategy, and entrepreneurial growth. She is completing an M.S. in Marketing Analytics and Strategy at UT Austin McCombs (expected May 2027; the specialized master's in marketing, not the MBA) and is seeking in-house roles in product marketing, product strategy, growth, and consumer insights in Austin, Seattle, San Diego, or remote U.S.

This site is Paige's portfolio. The answers on it are written and approved by Paige.

## Case studies
- [Wellness Membership Pricing](/wellness-conjoint.html): conjoint analysis and market simulation to decide which wellness membership to launch and at what price (graduate research project, simulated results)
- [Oura Member Value Study](/oura-member-value.html): a four-method research plan on what makes a wearable membership worth keeping (independent, unaffiliated, not yet fielded)
- [WedWallet Go-to-Market](/wedwallet.html): category definition, positioning, and launch strategy for wedding and event payment software (three-month contract, Oct-Dec 2025)
- [Bell Flight at SXSW](/bell-sxsw.html): SXSW panel programming and executive positioning that helped a defense manufacturer get counted as a technology company (agency work at Real Chemistry, 2019)
- [iFLY Growth Strategy](/ifly-growth.html): a repeatable story-platform system for national and local earned media across twelve markets (agency work at Edelman, 2017)
- [Ottobock x Invictus Games](/ottobock-invictus.html): media strategy that made an essential technician role visible at the 2017 Invictus Games (agency work at Edelman)
- [Kindred Care Caregiver App](/kindred-care.html): human-centered UX prototype of a care-coordination app for family caregivers, with a clickable demo (graduate UX course project, concept prototype, not yet user-tested)

## Key facts
- Location: Austin, Texas. Open to Austin, Seattle, San Diego, or genuinely remote U.S. roles.
- Career: Weber Shandwick, Edelman, and Real Chemistry; founder of Paige Vaughn Photo; marketing and partnerships contractor for WedWallet (Perlyn); market research and strategy lead for Texas CPG.
- Clients and brands supported include Bank of America, General Motors, Shell Oil Retail, HP, Comcast, Bell Flight, iFLY, Ottobock, and the U.S. Army.
- Education: M.S. in Marketing Analytics and Strategy, UT Austin McCombs (expected May 2027); B.S. in Public Relations and Writing, Texas State University (2015).
- Strengths: turning customer insight into positioning, pricing, product, and growth decisions; pairing agency rigor with founder-level ownership; growing depth in analytics and AI-enabled workflows.
